mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A supply chain disruption regime (INDPRO declining below 100 for two consecutive months) reduces manufacturing output and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 150,000 new jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 annual growth above 2.5%), consumer demand saturation triggers profit margin compression and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic slowdown in manufacturing and construction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
